description: Partial demolition and reconstruction of the rear part of the building; Erection of rear extensions at lower ground, upper ground, first and second floor levels; alterations to the main roof including formation of a butterfly roof involving an increase in the ridge height, installation of a rooflight and replacement of the existing dormer with an enlarged dormer roof extension in the rear roofslope; formation of roof terraces at upper ground and first floor levels to the rear elevation; alterations to the rear elevation including new and revised window and door openings; alterations to the rear external staircase; replacement of existing windows; conversion of the existing building from 2no self-contained flats into a single family dwellinghouse.
